items.title: Loveseat Living Room for a Small Flat
items.description: Make a tiny flat feel spacious with a two-seater sofa, one large print and a tripod floor lamp. A budget-friendly, minimalist small-space idea.

image.alt: Small living room with a light blue two-seater sofa, navy and mustard cushions, a framed landscape print and a tripod lamp

items.title: Sage Green Home Office Corner in a Small Living Room
items.description: Create a calm work-from-home corner with a sage green wall, a slim desk, a pinboard of ideas and plants, all inside a small living room.

image.alt: Home office corner with a sage green wall, wooden desk with computer, black office chair, pinned artwork and plants by a bright window

items.title: Soft Neutral Living Nook for a Small Apartment
items.description: A calm small-apartment living room with a light grey sofa, round coffee table, wall lights and plants. Minimalist and budget-friendly.

image.alt: Small living room with a light grey sofa, white knitted throw, round wooden coffee table, wall lights and green plants

items.title: Studio Apartment Zones: Living, Dining and Storage in One Room
items.description: Divide an open-plan studio into living, dining and storage zones with a cube shelving unit, a rug and smart furniture placement.

image.alt: Open-plan loft with a white cube bookshelf, wooden dining table and chairs, a green sofa and exposed brick wall
